source_prompt: A woman with bright magenta hair in an ornate updo stands on the porch of a wooden house in a misty Louisiana swamp at sunset. She wears a green and gold Victorian dress with a white ruffled collar and holds a glowing purple energy whip in her right hand while a glowing purple sword rests on a table. A hamburger, french fries, and hot sauce float in front of her. In the background a giant cypress tree stands in the water as a massive purple swirling storm cloud with lightning, a cartoon face, and giant green tentacles emerges from the sky. Spanish moss, purple flowers, a heron, and a black cat in a hammock are visible.
